description: A real hand-built 9×9 crossword — 19 interlocking answers, across/down clues, check and reveal.

faqs.a: Click any clue to jump to its word, or click any square. Typing fills the letter and moves to the next square; arrow keys move around; Backspace deletes and steps back.
faqs.q: How do I fill in answers?

faqs.a: “Check” marks every wrong letter in red without revealing answers. “Reveal” fills the whole grid — use it when you're truly stuck.
faqs.q: What's the difference between Check and Reveal?

faqs.a: Yes — every word in this puzzle was hand-placed so that all 19 answers interlock like a newspaper crossword.

howto: Click a clue (or a square) to select a word.
Type letters — the cursor advances automatically.
Use Check to flag mistakes, Reveal to fill the grid.
Complete all 19 answers to finish the puzzle.
title: Crossword Puzzle
